item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia resumed missile and cluster warhead strikes on Kyiv, killing at least nine civilians and injuring dozens, while also hitting other Ukrainian locations. Ukrainian forces disclosed a new cruise missile called Filin and reported Russian units infiltrating rear areas through gas pipelines near Kupiansk and Khartiia. Ukraine announced a reduction in reliance on Chinese drones despite remaining capability gaps. Hackers linked to Russia used a decentralised network in a cyberattack against Ukrainian targets, and Ukraine struck a Russian electronic warfare station. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Indian and Bangladeshi nationals were killed in separate Houthi attacks on a Saudi oilfield and at the airport, and their bodies have been returned home.
